What is true about a Global temporary table?

options.text: The data in a global temporary table is private, such that data inserted by a session can only be accessed by that session.

The session-specific rows in a global temporary table can be preserved for the whole session if there is clause
ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS
If user disconnect the session and reconnect the session data will be still present in the table if user commit the transaction.

The session-specific rows in a global temporary table can be preserved for the current transaction if there is clause
ON COMMIT DELETE ROWS

solution:
A - The data in a global temporary table is private, such that data inserted by a session can only be accessed by that session. B - The session-specific rows in a global temporary table can be preserved for the whole session if there is clause
ON COMMIT PRESERVE ROWS D - The session-specific rows in a global temporary table can be preserved for the current transaction if there is clause
ON COMMIT DELETE ROWS
